description: Behaviors that already work. A candidate must keep every one of them passing; these exist to catch a change that buys an improvement on the motivating cases by breaking something else.

cases.description: The simple case still works without pagination.
cases.task: Report the path of the only file that mentions the literal string "solitary-marker". Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

expect.reason: A one-page answer must not regress into unnecessary paging or extra turns.

cases.description: Directory listing still distinguishes files from directories.
cases.task: List what is directly under the lib directory and say which entries are directories. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

expect.reason: Listing is the cheapest orientation step and must keep working.

cases.description: One answer may combine evidence from several files.
cases.task: Report every file that mentions the literal string "shared-marker", with the line number in each. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

expect.reason: Stopping at the first match is a regression; both files are evidence.

cases.description: Declining stays available and does not become the default.
cases.task: Report whether this repository contains a module that implements a distributed consensus protocol, citing the source if it does. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

expect.reason: Answering honestly that something is absent must survive a change that makes the agent more assertive.
